newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica to buy remaining stake in TISA in May.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica to buy remaining stake in TISA in May.

text.p: Telefonica de Espana chairman Juan Villalonga said the company in May would buy the remaining 24 percent state stake in Telefonica International, Tisa.
"In May, we'll make a deal which will leave Telefonica with the state's 24 percent stake in Tisa, said Villalonga in a interview published today by the newspaper El Pais.
Industry analysts said this stake could be worthy around 130 billion pesetas.

On Friday, as a part of a global deal, it was also announced that US-based MCI would have the option to buy up to 10 percent of Telefonica's International arm, Tisa, if Telefonica were to put up some of its 76.3 percent TISA stake.
